steps.expression: () => { const input=document.querySelector("[data-mention-fixture-box=\"Mixed kinds\"] textarea"); const mirrors=[...input.parentElement.querySelectorAll("[data-mention-highlighter]")]; const nodes=[input,...input.parentElement.querySelectorAll("[data-mention-highlighter], [data-mention-highlighter] *")]; const pose=JSON.stringify(nodes.map(n=>{const r=n.getBoundingClientRect(),s=getComputedStyle(n);return [r.x,r.y,r.width,r.height,n.scrollTop,n.scrollLeft,n.getAttribute("data-selected"),s.color,s.backgroundColor,s.webkitTextFillColor,s.transform,s.opacity];})); const finiteDone=!document.getAnimations().some(a=>a.effect?.getTiming().iterations!==Infinity&&a.playState==="running"); const records=window.__lodyMentionVisualReady ??= {}; const state=records["selection-all"] ??= {previous:"",stable:0}; state.stable=(input.parentElement.querySelectorAll("[data-mention-layer=chip] [data-selected]").length === 5 && input.selectionStart === 0 && input.selectionEnd === input.value.length) && finiteDone && pose===state.previous ? state.stable+1 : 0; state.previous=pose; return state.stable>=5; }

() => { const input=document.querySelector("[data-mention-fixture-box=\"Mixed kinds\"] textarea"); const mirrors=[...input.parentElement.querySelectorAll("[data-mention-highlighter]")]; const nodes=[input,...input.parentElement.querySelectorAll("[data-mention-highlighter], [data-mention-highlighter] *")]; const pose=JSON.stringify(nodes.map(n=>{const r=n.getBoundingClientRect(),s=getComputedStyle(n);return [r.x,r.y,r.width,r.height,n.scrollTop,n.scrollLeft,n.getAttribute("data-selected"),s.color,s.backgroundColor,s.webkitTextFillColor,s.transform,s.opacity];})); const finiteDone=!document.getAnimations().some(a=>a.effect?.getTiming().iterations!==Infinity&&a.playState==="running"); const records=window.__lodyMentionVisualReady ??= {}; const state=records["caret-at-end"] ??= {previous:"",stable:0}; state.stable=(input.selectionStart === input.value.length && input.selectionEnd === input.value.length && !input.parentElement.querySelector("[data-selected]") && mirrors.every(m => m.scrollTop === input.scrollTop && m.scrollLeft === input.scrollLeft)) && finiteDone && pose===state.previous ? state.stable+1 : 0; state.previous=pose; return state.stable>=5; }
